name: kader-cargo
description: Kader Cargo — plateforme de fret & tracking Chine → Togo (SPA React + API REST)

scripts.setup: node server/scripts/init-env.mjs && npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix server run db:deploy && npm --prefix server run db:seed
scripts.sync: node server/scripts/init-env.mjs && npm install --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error && npm --prefix server install --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error && npm --prefix web install --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error && npm --prefix server run db:deploy
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
